sources.excerpt: MXR® SUB OCTAVE BASS FUZZ - Dunlop Toggle menu Compare --> Register I Sign in Search Bag Search Close Products --> All Products --> --> Electronics MXR Cry Baby Way Huge Dunlop Electronics Authentic Hendrix Pedal Parts Electronic Parts Legacy Products Guitar Picks Tortex Nylon Max-Grip Jazz Herco Gator Grip Celluloid Ultex Primetone Delrin 500 Flow Finger & Thumb Stubby Variety Packs Artist Series Graphic Artist Series Pick Tins Other Clearance Accessories Capos Slides & Tonebars MXR Cables Care & Maintenance Strap Retainer Straps Tuners Pick Holders GrooveTech Tools Accu-Fret Fretwire Clearance Strings Artist Series Electric Bass Acoustic Classical Americana Ukulele Apparel Shirts Hoodies Hats Artists Lifestyle Sign in MXR® SUB OCTAVE BASS FUZZ M287 Description *LEGACY PRODUCT / NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION   The Sub Octave Bass Fuzz combines two different fuzzes with a growling sub octave signal, featuring an array of controls to fine-tune your sound, including a separate Dry volume control to ensure clean low end retention.   This pedal can be powered by a 9-volt battery, a Dunlop ECB003 9-volt adapter, or the DC Brick™, Iso-Brick™, and Mini Iso-Brick™ power supplies (not included). Warranty Information The Long Story The Sub Octave Bass Fuzz dishes out thunderous low end with earth-shaking fuzz. To create this sonic behemoth, MXR's engineers combined the Growl section of the Bass Octave Deluxe with a long-forgotten fuzz circuit. With three separate output level controls for the fuzz, sub octave, and dry signals, you can create your own recipe of subterranean tones without sacrificing any of your instrument's natural sound. Further versatility comes in the form of the fuzz section's tone controls and two switchable voices—warm and compressed or bright and aggressive—along with the Mid Level control, which allows you to give your dry signal some more punch in the midrange.
